system.description: • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex). No Disadvantage against the creature you've Challenged; on a hit, it has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.

activities.name: Challenger's Blow
activities.text: One additional weapon attack as part of your attack action, with Disadvantage that no Advantage cancels. Against your Challenged foe, a hit gives it Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.

activities.name: Challenger's Blow (against your Challenged foe)
activities.text: No Disadvantage on the extra attack (against your Challenged foe). Against your Challenged foe, a hit gives it Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.
